entries.title: Your mouth's ecosystem
entries.content: The mouth is home to many microbes that form a natural film on teeth. When the balance is off, cavities and gum problems are more likely.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Gums and whole-body health
entries.content: Research links long-term gum inflammation with other health conditions. Daily brushing, cleaning between teeth and dental checkups matter.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Probiotics and gums
entries.content: Some early studies look at probiotics for gum health, but the evidence is mixed. Brushing and cleaning between teeth come first.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
